She brought a little doll to class.
She did not cry at all.
She played with Khalida from the first day.
13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.explanation: Düzgün cavab C variantıdır. MƏNBƏ: Dərslikdəki mətndə Latifa deyir: 'I cried for a month. Finally, the teacher got angry and changed my seat.'
opts: She cried for a month until her seat was changed.
She brought a little doll to class.
She did not cry at all.
She played with Khalida from the first day.

13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.question: How did Latifa stop crying in the kindergarten?
options: Khalida gave her a little doll and they played together.
She went to sit at the last desk alone.
The teacher gave her some toys.
Her father came back to the classroom.
13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.explanation: Düzgün cavab C variantıdır. MƏNBƏ: Dərslikdə qeyd olunur: 'She took a little doll out of her bag and gave it to me. We started playing with the doll and I stopped crying.'
opts: Khalida gave her a little doll and they played together.
She went to sit at the last desk alone.
The teacher gave her some toys.
Her father came back to the classroom.

13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.question: What happened after Khalida moved to another city?
options: Latifa moved to the same city too.
They often called each other and talked about classes.
13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.explanation: Düzgün cavab C variantıdır. MƏNBƏ: Mətndə deyilir: 'Khalida moved to another city last year and changed her school, but it didn't end our friendship. We often call each other and love talking about our classes.'
opts: Latifa moved to the same city too.
They often called each other and talked about classes.

13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.question: Why did the teacher ask Elay to sit with Ayan?

opts: Because they were both the most hardworking students.
Because Elay broke his own pen.
Because Elay was making a lot of noise and the teacher wanted to punish him.

13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.question: What did Elay do to Ayan before they became friends?

He helped her with her homework.
He gave her a new pen.

Ayan gave Elay her favourite pen.

13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.question: If a person always tells the truth, they are considered:

13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.question: Which adjective describes someone who believes in their ability and success?

13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.question: A person who thinks positively about the future is called:

13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.question: "She is a great person. Yesterday she gave all her money to a homeless person." Which word best describes her?

13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.question: "He never tells lies. He is my role model." Which word best describes him?
13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.explanation: Düzgün cavab C variantıdır. MƏNBƏ: Dərslikdəki tərifə görə: 'Honest people always tell the truth.'

13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.question: "She knows all my secrets and never tells them to anyone." Which word best describes her?
13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.explanation: Düzgün cavab A variantıdır. MƏNBƏ: Dərslikdə qeyd edilib: 'You can trust reliable people.'

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: Which sentence correctly uses the Zero Conditional?
options: If you mix water and electricity, you get a shock.
If you mix water and electricity, you will get a shock.
If you mix water and electricity, you got a shock.
If you mixed water and electricity, you get a shock.
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslik qaydası: Ümumi faktları və həmişə doğru olan şeyləri bildirmək üçün hər iki hissədə İndiki Sadə (Present Simple) zaman istifadə olunur. MƏNBƏ: You use if or when with the Present Simple followed by the Present Simple in the main clause to talk about facts and things which are generally true. (If you mix water and electricity, you get a shock.)
opts: If you mix water and electricity, you get a shock.
If you mix water and electricity, you will get a shock.
If you mix water and electricity, you got a shock.
If you mixed water and electricity, you get a shock.

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: Complete the sentence using the Zero Conditional: If you heat ice, it ___.
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslikdə sıfırıncı şərt budaq cümləsi (Zero Conditional) ümumi həqiqətləri ifadə edir və hər iki tərəfdə Present Simple (İndiki Sadə zaman) istifadə olunur. Mübtəda 'it' olduğu üçün felin sonuna '-s' əlavə edilir. MƏNBƏ: If you heat ice, it melts.

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: Complete the sentence correctly: Plants ___ if they don't get enough water.
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslik qaydası: Ümumi faktları bildirərkən 'If + Present Simple, Present Simple' istifadə edilir. 'Plants' cəm ism olduğuna görə 'die' forması uyğundur. MƏNBƏ: Plants die if they don't get enough water.

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: What happens if people eat too much according to the Zero Conditional examples?
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslikdə verilmiş Zero Conditional nümunələrinə əsasən, faktlardan bəhs edərkən If + Present Simple, Present Simple qaydası tətbiq olunur. MƏNBƏ: If people eat too much, they get fat.

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: Which of the following is a correct First Conditional sentence?
options: If I will go there tomorrow, I meet my friends.
If I am going there tomorrow, I meet my friends.
If I go there tomorrow, I met my friends.
If I go there tomorrow, I will meet my friends.
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslik qaydası: Birinci şərt budaq cümləsi gələcəkdə baş verməsi mümkün olan hadisələr üçündür. Budaq cümlə İndiki Sadə (Present Simple), baş cümlə Gələcək (Future will) zamanla düzəlir. MƏNBƏ: We use the First Conditional to talk about something which is possible to happen in the future. (If I go there tomorrow, I will meet my friends.)
opts: If I will go there tomorrow, I meet my friends.
If I am going there tomorrow, I meet my friends.
If I go there tomorrow, I met my friends.
If I go there tomorrow, I will meet my friends.

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: Complete the sentence using the First Conditional: If we become friends, we ___ a lot of fun together.
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslikdə gələcəyə aid ehtimallar üçün First Conditional nümunəsi verilmişdir: If-clause (Present Simple), Main clause (will). MƏNBƏ: If we become friends, we will have a lot of fun together.

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: I will ask him to call you ___.
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslikdəki qaydaya görə baş cümlə (Main clause - will) əvvəldə də gələ bilər, lakin 'if' olan hissədə yenə də İndiki Sadə (Present Simple) zaman istifadə olunur. MƏNBƏ: If I see Nick, I'll ask him to call you.

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: Complete the sentence based on the First Conditional: If the weather is cold, we ___ on our coats.
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslik tapşırığına əsasən, müəyyən bir şərt ödənilərsə, gələcəkdəki hərəkəti (First Conditional) bildirmək üçün 'will' istifadə edilir. MƏNBƏ: If the weather is cold, we will put on our coats.

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: Choose the correct tense based on the Zero Conditional rule: Water ___ if you heat it to 100 °C.
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslikdə Zero Conditional elmi faktlar üçün işlənir, hər iki tərəfdə Present Simple olur. 'Water' sayılmayan və tək isim olduğu üçün feilə '-s' əlavə olunur. MƏNBƏ: Water boils if you heat it to 100 °C.

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: Read the sentence and choose the correct option: If it snows this winter, I ___ a snowman.
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslikdəki 'Review' hissəsində bu cümlə gələcəkdəki xüsusi və mümkün bir hadisə (First Conditional) olaraq qeyd edilmişdir. MƏNBƏ: If it snows this winter, I will make a snowman.

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: Complete the sentence: I don't go to school if I ___ sick.
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslikdə Zero Conditional üçün 'to be' felinin indiki zaman formalarından (am/is/are) istifadə olunduğu nümunə verilmişdir. Hər iki tərəf indiki zamandadır. MƏNBƏ: I don't go to school if I am sick.

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: Complete the sentence based on the textbook examples: If babies are hungry, they ___.
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslikdə Zero Conditional (ümumi həqiqət) nümunəsi kimi göstərilib: If + Present Simple, Present Simple. MƏNBƏ: If babies are hungry, they cry.

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: Complete the sentence: If they are late, their teacher ___ angry.
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslikdə verilmiş First Conditional nümunəsi olaraq gələcəkdə ehtimal olunan nəticəni bildirmək üçün 'will' istifadə edilmişdir. MƏNBƏ: If they are late, their teacher will be angry.

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: Which sentence shows the correct punctuation for a First Conditional sentence according to the textbook?
options: I will meet my friends, if I go there tomorrow.
If I will go there tomorrow, I meet my friends.
If I go there tomorrow I will meet my friends.
I will meet my friends if I go there tomorrow.
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslikdə xüsusi olaraq qeyd edilir ki, baş cümlə (Main clause) əvvəldə gəldikdə vergül qoyulmur, ancaq 'If' ilə başlayan cümlədə vergül qoyulur. MƏNBƏ: Pay attention to the punctuation. I will meet my friends if I go there tomorrow.
opts: I will meet my friends, if I go there tomorrow.
If I will go there tomorrow, I meet my friends.
If I go there tomorrow I will meet my friends.
I will meet my friends if I go there tomorrow.

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: Complete the sentence based on facts: If you mix red and green, you ___ brown.
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslikdə elmi həqiqətləri bildirmək üçün Zero Conditional işlədilir: If + Present Simple, Present Simple. MƏNBƏ: If you mix red and green, you get brown.

2. Grammar: Adjectives (-ed vs -ing; Too.explanation: Əşyalar və ya vəziyyətlər (oyunun qaydaları) insanda hiss yaratdığına görə '-ing' şəkilçili sifət istifadə olunur. MƏNBƏ: "I don't understand this game. The rules are very confusing/confused." (Unit 1, Grammar A)

2. Grammar: Adjectives (-ed vs -ing; Too.topic: 2. Grammar: Adjectives (-ed vs -ing; Too vs Enough)

2. Grammar: Adjectives (-ed vs -ing; Too.topic: 2. Grammar: Adjectives (-ed vs -ing; Too vs Enough)

2. Grammar: Adjectives (-ed vs -ing; Too.topic: 2. Grammar: Adjectives (-ed vs -ing; Too vs Enough)

2. Grammar: Adjectives (-ed vs -ing; Too.topic: 2. Grammar: Adjectives (-ed vs -ing; Too vs Enough)

2. Grammar: Adjectives (-ed vs -ing; Too.topic: 2. Grammar: Adjectives (-ed vs -ing; Too vs Enough)

4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.question: Where was William Kamkwamba born?
4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.explanation: Kamkwambanın anadan olduğu ölkə mətnin əvvəlində verilib. MƏNBƏ: 'William Kamkwamba was born in Malawi in Africa in 1987.'

4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.question: Why did William stop going to school in 2001?
options: He found a job in another city.
His family couldn't pay for his studies.
He wanted to build a windmill.
4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.explanation: William-ın məktəbdən çıxma səbəbi ailəsinin maddi vəziyyəti idi. MƏNBƏ: 'William stopped going to school because his family couldn't pay for his studies.'
opts: He found a job in another city.
His family couldn't pay for his studies.
He wanted to build a windmill.

4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.question: How did William Kamkwamba learn about different energy sources?
options: He learned it at school before he left.
His parents taught him about them.
He read a book called 'Using Energy' in the library.
He watched TV programmes on the weekends.
4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.explanation: O, enerji mənbələri barədə məlumatı kitabxanadakı kitabdan öyrənmişdi. MƏNBƏ: 'He liked science and enjoyed reading the book called Using Energy... Luckily, there were pictures of different energy sources and they helped William a lot.'
opts: He learned it at school before he left.
His parents taught him about them.
He read a book called 'Using Energy' in the library.
He watched TV programmes on the weekends.

4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.question: What did William build to get electricity for his house?
4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.explanation: Evinə elektrik enerjisi təmin etmək üçün o, yel dəyirmanı (windmill) tikmişdi. MƏNBƏ: 'William's house didn't have electricity, so he decided to build a windmill. He made a windmill and started getting electricity from it.'

4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.question: Who is Reyhan Jamalova?
options: A reading teacher from the USA.
A famous writer of children's books.
A travel blogger from the Netherlands.
4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.explanation: Reyhan Camalova Azərbaycanlı gənc ixtiraçıdır. MƏNBƏ: 'Reyhan Jamalova was born in 2002 in Azerbaijan... Reyhan is in the list of thirty young inventors.'
opts: A reading teacher from the USA.
A famous writer of children's books.
A travel blogger from the Netherlands.

4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.question: What is the main idea behind Reyhan's invention, Rainergy?
options: To use the energy from the sun.
To get energy from the wind.
To water the maize farms automatically.
4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.explanation: Rainergy cihazı yağış damcılarından enerji əldə etmək üçün nəzərdə tutulub. MƏNBƏ: 'They used the energy from rain and powered some lamps with the new device. They called the device Rainergy.'
opts: To use the energy from the sun.
To get energy from the wind.
To water the maize farms automatically.

4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.question: Which competition did Reyhan enter in 2017 with her invention?
4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.explanation: Reyhan Camalova 2017-ci ildə Climate Launchpad müsabiqəsinə qatılıb. MƏNBƏ: 'In 2017, Reyhan entered her invention into a European competition for new green technology ideas - Climate Launchpad.'

4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.question: Match the definition to the correct word: 'having very little money'.
4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.explanation: Lüğət hissəsində çox az pulu olmaq vəziyyəti 'poor' (kasıb) kimi verilib. MƏNBƏ: '4. having very little money' tərifi 'poor' sözünə aiddir.

4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.question: Which word means 'connected with the environment or its protection'?
4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.explanation: Ətraf mühitin qorunması ilə əlaqəli məfhum 'green' (yaşıl) adlanır. MƏNBƏ: '3. connected with the environment or its protection' tərifi 'green' sözünə aiddir.

4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.question: What does the adjective 'user-friendly' mean according to the vocabulary section?
options: It helps you do or get what you want.
It is hard to find users for the device.
It has no effect on people's lives.
4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.explanation: İstifadəçi üçün rahat olan əşyalar 'user-friendly' adlanır. MƏNBƏ: 'user-friendly: It is easy to use user-friendly devices.'
opts: It helps you do or get what you want.
It is hard to find users for the device.
It has no effect on people's lives.

4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.question: Complete the sentence correctly according to the vocabulary section: 'I don't need this information. It is very ___.'
4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.explanation: Ehtiyac duyulmayan informasiya faydasız, yəni 'useless' adlanır. MƏNBƏ: 'I don't need this information. It is very useless.'

4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.question: Which adjective means 'unusual and surprising'?
4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.explanation: Qeyri-adi və təəccüblü mənasını verən söz 'strange' sözüdür. MƏNBƏ: 'strange: Strange things are unusual and surprising.'

4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.question: Complete the sentence with the correct option: 'Heavy rain made it ___ to go for a walk.'
4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.explanation: Şiddətli yağış gəzməyə getməyi mümkünsüz edir. Lüğət tapşırığında da bu cür cümlə quruluşu var. MƏNBƏ: 'Heavy rain made it impossible to...'

4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.question: What was the result of William's second windmill?
options: He sold it to a European company.
He could water his father's maize farm.
He powered some lamps in a boat school.
He won the Climate Launchpad prize.
4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.explanation: William ikinci yel dəyirmanından alınan enerji ilə atasının qarğıdalı fermasını sulaya bilirdi. MƏNBƏ: 'With the energy he got from the second windmill, he could water his father's maize farm.'
opts: He sold it to a European company.
He could water his father's maize farm.
He powered some lamps in a boat school.
He won the Climate Launchpad prize.

4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.question: What kind of electricity does Reyhan want people all over the world to get?
4. Reading & Vocabulary: Young People &.explanation: Reyhan insanların ucuz və təbiətə zərərsiz (yaşıl) elektrik enerjisi almasını istəyirdi. MƏNBƏ: 'She wants people all over the world to get cheap and green electricity.'

5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.question: According to the grammar rules, why do we use "adjective + to infinitive"?
options: To talk about a past situation
5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.explanation: We use adjectives + to infinitives to express feelings or reactions. SOURCE: Unit 2, Grammar target: Adjectives and infinitives. "We use adjectives+to infinitives to express feelings or reactions."
opts: To talk about a past situation

5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.question: Complete the sentence based on the common adjectives: "It is _____ to invent new devices."
5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.explanation: The correct form is an adjective followed by a to-infinitive. SOURCE: Unit 2, Grammar target: Adjectives and infinitives. "It is possible to invent new devices."

5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.question: Which of the following is the correct structure to express a reaction to carrying something heavy?
options: It is difficult to carry it.
5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.explanation: The correct structure is adjective + to infinitive. SOURCE: Unit 2, Grammar target: Adjectives and infinitives. "It is difficult to carry it."
opts: It is difficult to carry it.

5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.question: Choose the correct sentence with "adjective + to infinitive".
options: It is wrong use a lot of toothpaste.
Having a food cooler is nicely.
Making a new invention is possible.
It is possible to invent new devices.
5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.explanation: We use an adjective followed by a to-infinitive. "possible" is the adjective. SOURCE: Unit 2, Grammar target: Adjectives and infinitives. "It is possible to invent new devices."
opts: It is wrong use a lot of toothpaste.
Having a food cooler is nicely.
Making a new invention is possible.
It is possible to invent new devices.

5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.question: Change the following sentence using an infinitive after the adjective: "Reading a story book is interesting."
options: It is interesting to read a story book.
It is interesting reading a story book.
Read a story book is interesting.
To read a story book is interestingly.
5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.explanation: The structure is It + is + adjective + to-infinitive. SOURCE: Unit 2, Review 2: "Change the sentences using an infinitive after the adjective. Reading a story book is interesting. -> It is interesting to read a story book."
opts: It is interesting to read a story book.
It is interesting reading a story book.
Read a story book is interesting.
To read a story book is interestingly.

5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.question: What is the meaning of "used to" in grammar?
options: To talk about a past situation that is no longer true
To talk about things we are accustomed to doing now
5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.explanation: "used to" describes past habits that are not true anymore. SOURCE: Unit 2, Grammar target: used to. "We use used to+infinitive to talk about a past situation that is no longer true."
opts: To talk about a past situation that is no longer true
To talk about things we are accustomed to doing now

5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.question: How do you make the negative form of "used to"?
5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.explanation: In the negative form, the 'd' is dropped. SOURCE: Unit 2, Grammar target: used to. "For negative, we use didn't use to."

5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.question: Complete the sentence with the correct form: "I _____ work on the computer." (negative)
5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.explanation: The negative form of used to is "didn't use to". SOURCE: Unit 2, Grammar target: used to. "I didn't use to work on the computer."

5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.question: Choose the correct question form to ask about past habits.
options: Do you use to ride horses?
Did you use to ride horses?
Did you used to ride horses?
Are you used to riding horses?
5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.explanation: For questions, we use 'Did' + subject + 'use to' + infinitive. SOURCE: Unit 2, Grammar target: used to. "Use did to ask about past habits. Did you use to ride horses?"
opts: Do you use to ride horses?
Did you use to ride horses?
Did you used to ride horses?
Are you used to riding horses?

5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.question: Complete the sentence based on the text: "People _____ travel on foot."
5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.explanation: To talk about past situations, we use "used to + infinitive". SOURCE: Unit 2, Grammar target: used to. "People used to travel on foot."

5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.question: Read the conversation from the text: Grandpa says, "About 100 years ago, there weren't any planes. People _____ ride horses or camels to get to faraway places." Which phrase completes the sentence?
5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.explanation: The grandfather is talking about a past situation that is no longer true. SOURCE: Unit 2, Grammar B. "They used to ride horses or camels to get to faraway places."

5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.question: Which sentence has a grammar mistake according to the rules in Unit 2?
options: Sarah used to have very long hair many years ago.
My uncle used to work as a waiter.
I didn't use to like country life.
Rebecca didn't used to play the guitar in her childhood.
5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.explanation: The negative form drops the "d". It should be "didn't use to". SOURCE: Unit 2, Review: Find the mistakes. "Rebecca didn’t used to play the guitar in her childhood." (incorrect sentence presented in the book).
opts: Sarah used to have very long hair many years ago.
My uncle used to work as a waiter.
I didn't use to like country life.
Rebecca didn't used to play the guitar in her childhood.

5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.question: Which pair of sentences shows the correct past and present contrast according to the textbook examples?
options: Years ago: I didn't play chess. Today: I often play chess.
Years ago: I used to have a parrot. Today: I have a parrot.
Years ago: I didn't use to run. Today: I didn't use to run.
Years ago: I used to drink coffee a lot. Today: I never drank coffee.
5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.explanation: "used to" contrasts a past habit with a present one. SOURCE: Unit 2, Review, Section 5: "Compare what Omar said 10 years ago and what he says today... 10 years ago: I didn't play chess. Today: I often play chess."
opts: Years ago: I didn't play chess. Today: I often play chess.
Years ago: I used to have a parrot. Today: I have a parrot.
Years ago: I didn't use to run. Today: I didn't use to run.
Years ago: I used to drink coffee a lot. Today: I never drank coffee.

5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.question: Change the following sentence to use an infinitive after the adjective: "Travelling without friends is boring."
options: It is boring to travel without friends.
It is boring travelling without friends.
5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.explanation: The structure is It + is + adjective + to-infinitive. SOURCE: Unit 2, Review, Section 2: "Travelling without friends is boring. -> It is boring to travel without friends."
opts: It is boring to travel without friends.
It is boring travelling without friends.

5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.question: Complete the sentence properly using 'used to' or 'didn't use to': "My brother _____ listen to the radio a lot, but he doesn't like it anymore."
5. Grammar: Adjectives + Infinitives; Us.explanation: The situation was true in the past but is no longer true. SOURCE: Unit 2, Review, Section 4: "My brother used to listen to the radio a lot, but he doesn’t like it anymore."

6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.question: Who was making fun of Trisha after classes?
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.explanation: Trisha-nı dərsdən sonra ələ salan şəxs Eric idi. MƏNBƏ: "After classes, Eric made fun of her and often called her 'Stupid!' or 'Ugly!'"
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.topic: 6. Story & Communication: Young Scientists & Expressing Anxiety

6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.question: Where did Trisha often hide during break times to feel safer?
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.explanation: Trisha özünü daha təhlükəsiz hiss etmək üçün pilləkənlərin altında gizlənirdi. MƏNBƏ: "During break times, Trisha often hid under the stairs. In that dark place, she felt safer."
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.topic: 6. Story & Communication: Young Scientists & Expressing Anxiety

6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.question: What did Eric say to Trisha when he found her secret hiding place?
options: I want to read a book.
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.explanation: Eric onun gizləndiyi yeri tapanda ona 'Sən köstəbəksən?' deyə gülmüşdü. MƏNBƏ: "Once Eric followed her to her secret place. 'Are you a mole?' he laughed."
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.topic: 6. Story & Communication: Young Scientists & Expressing Anxiety
opts: I want to read a book.

6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.question: What did Mr Falker do when he saw Eric making fun of Trisha?
options: He took Eric to the office.
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.explanation: Mr Falker Eric-in Trisha-nı ələ saldığını görəndə onu ofisə apardı. MƏNBƏ: "Suddenly, she heard footsteps. It was Mr Falker. He took Eric to the office."
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.topic: 6. Story & Communication: Young Scientists & Expressing Anxiety
opts: He took Eric to the office.

6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.question: What game did Mr Falker ask Trisha to play after school?
options: To draw pictures on the board
To build a house with blocks
To write the letters and numbers he shouted out
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.explanation: Mr Falker ondan onun dediyi hərfləri və rəqəmləri lövhədə yazmağını istədi. MƏNBƏ: "Let's play a game! I'll shout out letters and you'll write them on the board."
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.topic: 6. Story & Communication: Young Scientists & Expressing Anxiety
opts: To draw pictures on the board
To build a house with blocks
To write the letters and numbers he shouted out

6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.question: How did Mr Falker explain Trisha's problem with reading?
options: He said she was not trying hard enough.
He said she didn't see letters or numbers the way other people do.
He told her she was stupid.
He said she needed new glasses.
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.explanation: Mr Falker ona izah etdi ki, o, hərfləri və rəqəmləri digər insanların gördüyü kimi görmür. MƏNBƏ: "But, little one, don't you understand you don't see letters or numbers the way other people do?"
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.topic: 6. Story & Communication: Young Scientists & Expressing Anxiety
opts: He said she was not trying hard enough.
He said she didn't see letters or numbers the way other people do.
He told her she was stupid.
He said she needed new glasses.

6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.question: What did Mr Falker promise Trisha after he cleaned the board?
options: That he would buy her a book
That she would get a good grade
That she was going to read
That Eric would become her friend
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.explanation: Mr Falker Trisha-ya oxumağı öyrənəcəyinə söz verdi. MƏNBƏ: "We're going to change all that, girl. You're going to read! I promise you that."
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.topic: 6. Story & Communication: Young Scientists & Expressing Anxiety
opts: That he would buy her a book
That she would get a good grade
That she was going to read
That Eric would become her friend

6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.question: Who helped Mr Falker to teach Trisha how to read?
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.explanation: Trisha-ya oxumağı öyrətməkdə Mr Falker ilə birlikdə oxu müəllimi Miss Plessy də kömək edirdi. MƏNBƏ: "Every day after school, she met with Mr Falker and Miss Plessy, a reading teacher."
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.topic: 6. Story & Communication: Young Scientists & Expressing Anxiety

6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.question: What did Trisha make at first to help her understand letters?
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.explanation: İlk olaraq Trisha qumda və lövhədə dairələr çəkirdi. MƏNBƏ: "At first, she made circles in sand, and then she wrote big circles on the blackboard."
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.topic: 6. Story & Communication: Young Scientists & Expressing Anxiety

6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.question: What did Trisha use to build words with?
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.explanation: O, sözləri qurmaq üçün taxta bloklardan istifadə edirdi. MƏNBƏ: "Other days, she worked with wooden blocks and built words."
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.topic: 6. Story & Communication: Young Scientists & Expressing Anxiety

6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.question: How long did it take before Mr Falker put a book in front of her to read a paragraph?
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.explanation: Üç ay sonra Mr Falker ona bir abzas oxutmaq üçün önünə kitab qoydu. MƏNBƏ: "Three months later, Mr Falker put a book in front of her. He asked Trisha to read a paragraph."
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.topic: 6. Story & Communication: Young Scientists & Expressing Anxiety

6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.question: What happened when Trisha finally read a paragraph?
options: She ran away from the classroom.
She started to draw a picture.
Mr Falker and Miss Plessy had tears in their eyes.
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.explanation: Trisha nəhayət bir abzas oxuyanda müəllimlərin gözləri yaşardı. MƏNBƏ: "And finally, she read a paragraph. Mr Falker and Miss Plessy had tears in their eyes."
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.topic: 6. Story & Communication: Young Scientists & Expressing Anxiety
opts: She ran away from the classroom.
She started to draw a picture.
Mr Falker and Miss Plessy had tears in their eyes.

6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.question: Who is the author of the story, who was actually the little girl Trisha?
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.explanation: Hekayədəki balaca qız əslində müəllifin özü, yəni Patricia Polacco idi. MƏNBƏ: "I know because that little girl was me, Patricia Polacco."
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.topic: 6. Story & Communication: Young Scientists & Expressing Anxiety

6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.question: When did Patricia see Mr Falker again after school?
options: Thirty years later at a party
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.explanation: Patricia Mr Falker-i təxminən otuz il sonra bir şənlikdə yenidən gördü. MƏNBƏ: "I saw Mr Falker again some thirty years later at a party."
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.topic: 6. Story & Communication: Young Scientists & Expressing Anxiety
opts: Thirty years later at a party

6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.question: According to the Listening section in the textbook, who is Tural Khudiyev?
6. Story & Communication: Young Scientis.explanation: Dərslikdəki Dinləmə bölməsində Tural Xudiyev gənc azərbaycanlı alim kimi təqdim olunur. MƏNBƏ: "Listen to an interview with Tural Khudiyev, a young Azerbaijani scientist and complete the sentence."

7. Reading & Vocabulary: Talented People.question: What makes Lee Hadwin a unique artist?
options: He draws pictures in his sleep.
He can calculate numbers very fast.
He uses only bright colors in his drawings.

opts: He draws pictures in his sleep.
He can calculate numbers very fast.
He uses only bright colors in his drawings.

7. Reading & Vocabulary: Talented People.topic: 7. Reading & Vocabulary: Talented People & Phrasal Verbs

7. Reading & Vocabulary: Talented People.question: Complete the sentence: 'Do it now. Don't ________ it ________ for tomorrow.'

7. Reading & Vocabulary: Talented People.topic: 7. Reading & Vocabulary: Talented People & Phrasal Verbs

7. Reading & Vocabulary: Talented People.topic: 7. Reading & Vocabulary: Talented People & Phrasal Verbs

7. Reading & Vocabulary: Talented People.question: Complete the sentence: 'Try as hard as you can. Successful people never ________.'

7. Reading & Vocabulary: Talented People.topic: 7. Reading & Vocabulary: Talented People & Phrasal Verbs

7. Reading & Vocabulary: Talented People.topic: 7. Reading & Vocabulary: Talented People & Phrasal Verbs

7. Reading & Vocabulary: Talented People.question: Complete the sentence: 'I ________ listening to my sister in the concert. It is going to be a very big moment for our family.'

7. Reading & Vocabulary: Talented People.question: Which phrasal verb means 'to be very successful'?

10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.question: William Bakker wanted to become a ... in his childhood.
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.explanation: Mətndə Vilyamın uşaqlığında pilot olmaq istədiyi qeyd edilir. MƏNBƏ: "In my childhood, I wanted to travel the world as a pilot..."
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.topic: 10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Blogging & Travel Expressions

10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.question: Why did William decide to post in English on his blog?
options: Because he wanted to move to England.
Because he didn't know his home country's language.
Because English is easier than his native language.
Because he wanted to reach the whole world.
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.explanation: Vilyam ingiliscə yazmağa qərar verdi ki, paylaşımları təkcə öz ölkəsinə yox, bütün dünyaya çata bilsin. MƏNBƏ: "I decided to post in English because I wanted to reach the whole world, not just my home country."
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.topic: 10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Blogging & Travel Expressions
opts: Because he wanted to move to England.
Because he didn't know his home country's language.
Because English is easier than his native language.
Because he wanted to reach the whole world.

10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.question: How does William react to negative comments on social media now?
options: He gets very angry and complains to everyone.
He doesn't care and ignores the negativity.
He stops posting new photos on his blog.
He deletes all the negative comments immediately.
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.explanation: Mətndə Vilyamın artıq mənfi şərhlərə əhəmiyyət vermədiyi və mənfilikləri gözardı etdiyi bildirilir. MƏNBƏ: "...now I don't really care what others are saying about me. My travels make me strong enough to ignore the negativity around me."
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.topic: 10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Blogging & Travel Expressions
opts: He gets very angry and complains to everyone.
He doesn't care and ignores the negativity.
He stops posting new photos on his blog.
He deletes all the negative comments immediately.

10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.question: What is William's main goal on social media?
options: To make a lot of money
To inspire others with his lifestyle
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.explanation: Vilyamın əsas məqsədi öz həyat tərzi ilə başqalarını ruhlandırmaqdır. MƏNBƏ: "I just want to inspire others with my lifestyle."
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.topic: 10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Blogging & Travel Expressions
opts: To make a lot of money
To inspire others with his lifestyle

10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.question: Which of the following does William NOT mention taking with him when he leaves the house?
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.explanation: Vilyamın səyahət edərkən özü ilə götürdüyü əşyalar arasında pasportun adı çəkilmir. MƏNBƏ: "...never leave the house without my mobile phone, phone charger, laptop, camera, a pair of sunglasses and a few watches."
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.topic: 10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Blogging & Travel Expressions

10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.question: According to William, what do New York and Dubai have in common?
options: They have the best local food.
They are unlike any other city in the whole world.
They are very close to each other.
They are the cheapest cities in the world.
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.explanation: Vilyamın fikrincə, Nyu-York və Dubay dünyadakı heç bir başqa şəhərə bənzəmir. MƏNBƏ: "...both cities have one thing in common: they are unlike any other city in the whole world."
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.topic: 10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Blogging & Travel Expressions
opts: They have the best local food.
They are unlike any other city in the whole world.
They are very close to each other.
They are the cheapest cities in the world.

10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.question: Choose the correct word for the definition: "a company that helps with travel preparations".
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.explanation: Səyahət hazırlıqlarında kömək edən şirkət "travel agency" (səyahət agentliyi) adlanır. MƏNBƏ: "travel agency - a company that helps with travel preparations"
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.topic: 10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Blogging & Travel Expressions

10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.question: If you want to visit a number of places by a ship or boat, you...
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.explanation: Gəmi və ya qayıqla bir neçə yeri ziyarət etmək "go on a cruise" (kruizə çıxmaq) adlanır. MƏNBƏ: "go on a cruise - visit a number of places by a ship or boat"
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.topic: 10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Blogging & Travel Expressions

10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.question: What do we call a person who gives information about places of interest?
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.explanation: Görməli yerlər haqqında məlumat verən şəxs "tour guide" (bələdçi) adlanır. MƏNBƏ: "tour guide - a person who gives information about places of interest"
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.topic: 10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Blogging & Travel Expressions

10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.question: Which word means "the bags that you put your things in and take with you when travelling"?
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.explanation: Səyahət edərkən əşyaları qoyduğunuz çantalar "luggage" (baqaj) adlanır. MƏNBƏ: "luggage - the bags that you put your things in and take with you when travelling"
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.topic: 10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Blogging & Travel Expressions

10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.question: If you buy a ticket to travel to your destination and back, it is a...
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.explanation: Gediş və dönüş üçün olan bilet "return ticket" (gediş-dönüş bileti) adlanır. MƏNBƏ: "return ticket - a ticket to travel to your destination, and back"
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.topic: 10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Blogging & Travel Expressions

10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.question: What does William like wearing when he travels?
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.explanation: Vilyam səyahət edərkən böyük ölçülü (oversized) sviterlər geyinməyi xoşlayır. MƏNBƏ: "I like travelling in oversized sweaters..."
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.topic: 10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Blogging & Travel Expressions

10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.question: To "complain" means to...
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.explanation: Şikayət etmək (complain) bir şey barədə narazılıq və ya bədbəxt hisslərini bölüşmək deməkdir. MƏNBƏ: "to complain - share unhappy feelings about sth"
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.topic: 10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Blogging & Travel Expressions

10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.question: Which of the following places is on William's travel to-do list?
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.explanation: Vilyamın səyahət etmək istədiyi yerlər siyahısında (to-do list) Tokio da var. MƏNBƏ: "It includes Cuba, Tokyo, Santorini..."
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.topic: 10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Blogging & Travel Expressions

10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.question: Choose the correct definition for "destination".
options: A place where someone is going
A ticket to travel only one way
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.explanation: Təyinat yeri (destination) bir şəxsin getdiyi yerdir. MƏNBƏ: "destination - a place where someone is going"
10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Bloggin.topic: 10. Reading & Vocabulary: Travel Blogging & Travel Expressions
opts: A place where someone is going
A ticket to travel only one way

11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.question: Choose the correct tag question: "Leyla works hard, _____?"
11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.explanation: Düzgün cavab 'doesn't she' olacaq, çünki təsdiq cümlələrində (affirmative) inkar 'tag' (negative tag) istifadə olunur və 'works' feli Present Simple zamanında olduğu üçün köməkçi fel olaraq 'doesn't' seçilir. MƏNBƏ: 'When the sentence is affirmative, we use a negative tag question. Leyla works hard, doesn't she?'

11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.question: Choose the correct alternative question.
options: Did you travel abroad and within Azerbaijan?
Did you travel abroad or within Azerbaijan?
Where did you travel, abroad or within Azerbaijan?
You travelled abroad or within Azerbaijan?
11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.explanation: Alternativ suallar köməkçi fel və ya modal fel ilə başlayır, cavab variantları arasında isə 'or' bağlayıcısı işlənir. MƏNBƏ: 'Alternative Questions start with the auxiliary verb / modal verb ... have the connecting word or ... (Did you travel abroad or within Azerbaijan?)'
opts: Did you travel abroad and within Azerbaijan?
Did you travel abroad or within Azerbaijan?
Where did you travel, abroad or within Azerbaijan?
You travelled abroad or within Azerbaijan?

11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.question: Complete the sentence with the correct tag question: "We didn't feel bored at all, _____?"
11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.explanation: İnkar cümlələrində (negative) təsdiq 'tag' (affirmative tag) istifadə olunur. MƏNBƏ: 'When the sentence is negative, we use an affirmative tag question. We didn't feel bored at all, did we?'

11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.question: Choose the correct option to complete the question: "Mr Burton and his family went hiking last year, _____?"
11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.explanation: Cümlənin mübtədası cəmdədir ('Mr Burton and his family' - they), feli isə Past Simple (went) təsdiq formasındadır, ona görə inkar 'tag' kimi 'didn't they' seçilir. MƏNBƏ: 'Mr Burton and his family went hiking last year, didn't they?'

11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.question: Which of the following is a correctly formed alternative question?
options: Does Tim often travels by plane or by car?
Tim often travels by plane or by car?
Do Tim often travel by plane or by car?
Does Tim often travel by plane or by car?
11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.explanation: Alternativ sualda mübtədaya uyğun köməkçi fel cümlənin əvvəlinə keçir (Does Tim) və əsas fel başlanğıc formaya (travel) qayıdır, həmçinin seçimlər 'or' ilə bağlanır. MƏNBƏ: 'Alternative Questions start with the auxiliary verb ... or/plane/Tim/travel/car/by/Does/by/often? -> Does Tim often travel by plane or by car?'
opts: Does Tim often travels by plane or by car?
Tim often travels by plane or by car?
Do Tim often travel by plane or by car?
Does Tim often travel by plane or by car?

11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.question: Choose the correct tag question: "The travellers were exhausted after the long walk, _____?"
11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.explanation: Təsdiq cümləsindəki 'were' feli inkar 'tag' hissəsində 'weren't' olacaq, həmçinin 'The travellers' üçün əvəzlik 'they' istifadə edilir. MƏNBƏ: 'The travellers were exhausted after the long walk, weren't they?'

11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.question: Complete the question: "This football match will be exciting enough, _____?"
11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.explanation: Təsdiq cümləsindəki 'will' köməkçi feli inkar 'tag' hissəsində 'won't' olmalıdır. 'This football match' cansız isim olduğu üçün 'it' əvəzliyi ilə əvəzlənir. MƏNBƏ: 'This football match will be exciting enough, won't it?'

11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.question: Complete the sentence with the correct tag question: "You cannot take a nap during the show, _____?"
11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.explanation: Cümlə inkar ('cannot') olduğu üçün, 'tag' hissəsi təsdiq olacaq ('can you'). MƏNBƏ: 'You cannot take a nap during the show, can you?'

11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.question: Choose the correct option: "Bella and her sister speak four languages, _____?"
11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.explanation: Mübtəda 'Bella and her sister' cəmdə olduğu üçün 'they' əvəzliyindən istifadə edilir. 'Speak' feli Present Simple-da və təsdiqdədir, deməli inkar 'tag' olaraq 'don't they' seçiləcək. MƏNBƏ: 'Bella and her sister speak four languages, don't they?'

11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.question: Put the words in the correct order to make an alternative question: "older / you / Is / sister / your / or / younger / than / ?"
options: Is your sister older or younger than you?
Is you older or younger than your sister?
Your sister is older or younger than you?
Is your sister older than you or younger?
11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.explanation: Sual cümləsində sözlərin düzgün ardıcıllığı: Köməkçi fel (Is) + Mübtəda (your sister) + Seçim 1 (older) + or + Seçim 2 (younger) + digər üzvlər. MƏNBƏ: '.than/you/older/your/younger/ls/sister/or? -> Is your sister older or younger than you?'
opts: Is your sister older or younger than you?
Is you older or younger than your sister?
Your sister is older or younger than you?
Is your sister older than you or younger?

11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.question: Complete the question: "Your cousins don't come to your party every year, _____?"
11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.explanation: Cümlə 'don't' ilə inkardadır, mübtəda 'cousins' isə cəmdədir. Buna görə 'tag' təsdiq olmalı və 'they' ilə işlənməlidir ('do they'). MƏNBƏ: 'Your cousins don't come to your party every year, do they?'

11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.question: Complete the tag question: "Farid was in the park yesterday evening, _____?"
11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.explanation: Əsas cümlədəki 'was' feli (təsdiq) 'tag' hissəsində inkar 'wasn't' formasında yazılır. Farid -> he. MƏNBƏ: 'Farid was in the park yesterday evening, wasn't he?'

11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.question: Choose the correct tag: "Marie's son always visits her, _____?"
11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.explanation: 'visits' (Present Simple, III şəxs təki) felinə uyğun olaraq köməkçi fel 'does' və cümlə təsdiqdə olduğuna görə inkar 'tag' 'doesn't he' olacaq. MƏNBƏ: 'Marie's son always visits her, doesn't he?'

11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.question: "It isn't raining now, _____?"
11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.explanation: Cümlədəki fel 'isn't' olduğu üçün sualın sonundakı 'tag' təsdiq 'is it' olacaq. MƏNBƏ: 'It isn't raining now, is it?'

11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.question: Which of the following is correct for making an alternative question based on this sentence: "My friends are planning to have a picnic on Saturday or Sunday."
options: Do my friends planning to have a picnic on Saturday or Sunday?
Are my friends planning to have a picnic on Saturday and Sunday?
Are my friends planning to have a picnic on Saturday or Sunday?
Have my friends planning to have a picnic on Saturday or Sunday?
11. Grammar: Tag Questions & Alternative.explanation: Alternativ sual mübtədaya uyğun köməkçi fellə (Are) başlayır və seçimlər 'or' ilə bağlanır. MƏNBƏ: 'Alternative Questions start with the auxiliary verb (am/is/are)... My friends are planning to have a picnic on Saturday or Sunday -> Are your/my friends planning to have a picnic on Saturday or Sunday?'
opts: Do my friends planning to have a picnic on Saturday or Sunday?
Are my friends planning to have a picnic on Saturday and Sunday?
Are my friends planning to have a picnic on Saturday or Sunday?
Have my friends planning to have a picnic on Saturday or Sunday?

12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.question: What did Uncle Kevin suggest Tyler do to feel better?
12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.explanation: Dayısı Kevin Taylerə özünü daha yaxşı hiss etməsi üçün gitara çalmağı təklif edir. MƏNBƏ: “You know, Tyler, I think you need to play the guitar right now. I am sure it will help,” he told me.
12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.topic: 12. Story & Communication: Travel Experiences & Giving Thanks

12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.question: Where did Tyler and Uncle Kevin go to play the guitar?
12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.explanation: Onlar gitara çalmaq üçün bağçaya çıxırlar. MƏNBƏ: "We went out to the garden and I started playing the guitar."
12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.topic: 12. Story & Communication: Travel Experiences & Giving Thanks

12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.question: How did Tyler feel when he was around his friend Jake?
12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.explanation: Ceyk bir çox şeydə Taylerden daha yaxşı olduğu üçün Tyler onun yanında özünü məğlub (loser) kimi hiss edirdi. MƏNBƏ: "I feel like a loser when I’m around him."
12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.topic: 12. Story & Communication: Travel Experiences & Giving Thanks

12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.question: Why did Carlos tell Oscar that he didn't like Jake?
options: Because Jake didn't play with him
Because Jake was not good at sports
12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.explanation: Karlos Oskar'a Ceykin onu həmişə qıcıqlandırdığı (annoyed) üçün ondan xoşu gəlmədiyini deyib. MƏNBƏ: "Once Carlos told Oscar that he didn’t like Jake at all because he always annoyed him."
12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.topic: 12. Story & Communication: Travel Experiences & Giving Thanks
opts: Because Jake didn't play with him
Because Jake was not good at sports

12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.question: What kind of fish did Uncle Kevin compare Jake to?
12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.explanation: Dayı Kevin Ceyki köpəkbalığına yox, kirpi balığına (pufferfish) bənzətdi. MƏNBƏ: "...people like Jake are like the pufferfish"
12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.topic: 12. Story & Communication: Travel Experiences & Giving Thanks

12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.question: Why do pufferfish puff up their bodies according to Uncle Kevin?
options: To make themselves bigger than they actually are
12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.explanation: Kirpi balıqları özlərini olduqlarından daha böyük göstərmək üçün şişirdirlər. MƏNBƏ: "They puff up their bodies to make themselves bigger than they actually are."
12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.topic: 12. Story & Communication: Travel Experiences & Giving Thanks
opts: To make themselves bigger than they actually are

12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.question: What happens when a kid acts like a pufferfish, according to the story?
options: He becomes the most popular kid
He takes up so much space that he pushes away friends
12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.explanation: Bir uşaq kirpi balığı kimi davrandıqda o qədər yer tutur ki, dostlarını da özündən uzaqlaşdırır. MƏNBƏ: “When a kid acts like a pufferfish, he takes up so much space that he can also push away friends.”
12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.topic: 12. Story & Communication: Travel Experiences & Giving Thanks
opts: He becomes the most popular kid
He takes up so much space that he pushes away friends

12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.question: Where did Tyler go after Uncle Kevin left?
12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.explanation: Kevin dayı getdikdən sonra Tyler velosipedini məktəb həyətinə sürdü. MƏNBƏ: "After Uncle Kevin left, I rode my bike to the schoolyard."

12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.question: Who was in the schoolyard when Tyler arrived?

12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.topic: 12. Story & Communication: Travel Experiences & Giving Thanks

12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.question: What were Jake and Niko doing in the schoolyard?
12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.explanation: Ceyk və Niko Frizbi atırdılar. MƏNBƏ: "...Jake and Niko, this new kid on my street, were throwing a Frisbee."
12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.topic: 12. Story & Communication: Travel Experiences & Giving Thanks

12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.question: What did Jake say when Niko did an amazing throw?
options: "That's nothing. Look what I can do."
"Can you teach me how to do it?"
12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.explanation: Niko əla atış edəndə Ceyk yenə lovğalandı və bunun heç nə olduğunu dedi. MƏNBƏ: "And then Jake did what he does best. He puffed up. 'That’s nothing,' he said. 'Look what I can do.'"
12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.topic: 12. Story & Communication: Travel Experiences & Giving Thanks
opts: "That's nothing. Look what I can do."
"Can you teach me how to do it?"

12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.question: How did Niko react when Tyler praised his amazing throw?
options: He threw the Frisbee at Jake
He offered to teach Tyler how to do it
12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.explanation: Tyler Nikonu tərifləyəndə, Niko ona bunu necə edəcəyini öyrətməyi təklif etdi. MƏNBƏ: "'Thanks. I can teach you how to do it.'"
12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.topic: 12. Story & Communication: Travel Experiences & Giving Thanks
opts: He threw the Frisbee at Jake
He offered to teach Tyler how to do it

12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.question: What did Jake do after Niko offered to show him how to do the throw?
options: He taught Niko his own throws
He said he knew all the cool throws and walked away
12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.explanation: Niko Ceykə də öyrədə biləcəyini deyəndə, Ceyk ehtiyacı olan bütün atışları bildiyini deyərək oradan uzaqlaşdı. MƏNBƏ: "'Well, I know all the cool throws I need to know,' said Jake and walked away."
12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.topic: 12. Story & Communication: Travel Experiences & Giving Thanks
opts: He taught Niko his own throws
He said he knew all the cool throws and walked away

12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.question: What did Tyler promise to teach Niko?
12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.explanation: Nikonun gitarası var idi amma çala bilmirdi, buna görə də Tyler ona gitara çalmağı öyrədəcəyinə söz verdi. MƏNBƏ: "'I’ll teach you how to play it,' I said to Niko."
12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.topic: 12. Story & Communication: Travel Experiences & Giving Thanks

12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.question: How does the story end for Tyler and Niko?
options: They decide to stop playing Frisbee
Tyler feels they are going to be really good friends
12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.explanation: Hekayənin sonunda Tyler Niko ilə çox yaxşı dost olacaqlarını hiss edir. MƏNBƏ: "You know what? I have a feeling that Niko and I are going to be really good friends."
12. Story & Communication: Travel Experi.topic: 12. Story & Communication: Travel Experiences & Giving Thanks
opts: They decide to stop playing Frisbee
Tyler feels they are going to be really good friends

13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.question: Which of the following is true about Latifa's first month at the kindergarten?
options: She cried for a month until her seat was changed.
She brought a little doll to class.
She did not cry at all.
She played with Khalida from the first day.
13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.explanation: Düzgün cavab C variantıdır. MƏNBƏ: Dərslikdəki mətndə Latifa deyir: 'I cried for a month. Finally, the teacher got angry and changed my seat.'
opts: She cried for a month until her seat was changed.
She brought a little doll to class.
She did not cry at all.
She played with Khalida from the first day.

13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.question: How did Latifa stop crying in the kindergarten?
options: Khalida gave her a little doll and they played together.
She went to sit at the last desk alone.
The teacher gave her some toys.
Her father came back to the classroom.
13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.explanation: Düzgün cavab C variantıdır. MƏNBƏ: Dərslikdə qeyd olunur: 'She took a little doll out of her bag and gave it to me. We started playing with the doll and I stopped crying.'
opts: Khalida gave her a little doll and they played together.
She went to sit at the last desk alone.
The teacher gave her some toys.
Her father came back to the classroom.

13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.question: What happened after Khalida moved to another city?
options: Latifa moved to the same city too.
They often called each other and talked about classes.
13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.explanation: Düzgün cavab C variantıdır. MƏNBƏ: Mətndə deyilir: 'Khalida moved to another city last year and changed her school, but it didn't end our friendship. We often call each other and love talking about our classes.'
opts: Latifa moved to the same city too.
They often called each other and talked about classes.

13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.question: Why did the teacher ask Elay to sit with Ayan?
options: Because they were both the most hardworking students.
Because Elay broke his own pen.
Because Elay was making a lot of noise and the teacher wanted to punish him.
13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.explanation: Düzgün cavab B variantıdır. MƏNBƏ: Mətndə yazılıb: 'One day, Elay made a lot of noise and our teacher wanted to punish him. She asked him to sit with me - the most hardworking student...'
opts: Because they were both the most hardworking students.
Because Elay broke his own pen.
Because Elay was making a lot of noise and the teacher wanted to punish him.

13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.question: What did Elay do to Ayan before they became friends?
options: He took her lunch and drew on her notebooks.
He brought her a slice of chocolate cake.
He helped her with her homework.
He gave her a new pen.
13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.explanation: Düzgün cavab A variantıdır. MƏNBƏ: Dərslikdə qeyd edilir: 'He often made me angry - took my lunch, drew on my notebooks, poured juice on my bag and pushed me during breaks.'
opts: He took her lunch and drew on her notebooks.
He brought her a slice of chocolate cake.
He helped her with her homework.
He gave her a new pen.

13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.question: How did Elay and Ayan's friendship start?
options: Elay saved slices of his birthday cake for Ayan.
They went to the director's room together.
The teacher told them to be friends.
Ayan gave Elay her favourite pen.
13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.explanation: Düzgün cavab B variantıdır. MƏNBƏ: Dərslikdə Ayan deyir: 'Suddenly, he came to me and whispered in my ear, "I saved these slices for you." Now he is my best friend.'
opts: Elay saved slices of his birthday cake for Ayan.
They went to the director's room together.
The teacher told them to be friends.
Ayan gave Elay her favourite pen.

13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.question: What is the future dream of Elay and Ayan?
13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.explanation: Düzgün cavab C variantıdır. MƏNBƏ: Mətndə aydın şəkildə yazılıb: 'We both want to become doctors one day.'

13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.question: If a person always tells the truth, they are considered:
13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.explanation: Düzgün cavab C variantıdır. MƏNBƏ: Lüğət bölməsində verilib: 'Honest people always tell the truth.'

13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.question: Which adjective describes someone who believes in their ability and success?
13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.explanation: Düzgün cavab B variantıdır. MƏNBƏ: Lüğət bölməsində yazılıb: 'Confident people believe in their ability and success.'

13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.question: A person who thinks positively about the future is called:
13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.explanation: Düzgün cavab B variantıdır. MƏNBƏ: Dərslikdə qeyd olunur: 'Optimistic people always think positively.'

13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.question: "She is a great person. Yesterday she gave all her money to a homeless person." Which word best describes her?
13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.explanation: Düzgün cavab A variantıdır. MƏNBƏ: Lüğətə əsasən: 'Generous people are ready to give their money or spend their time to help others.'

13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.question: "He never tells lies. He is my role model." Which word best describes him?
13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.explanation: Düzgün cavab C variantıdır. MƏNBƏ: Dərslikdəki tərifə görə: 'Honest people always tell the truth.'

13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.question: "She knows all my secrets and never tells them to anyone." Which word best describes her?
13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.explanation: Düzgün cavab A variantıdır. MƏNBƏ: Dərslikdə qeyd edilib: 'You can trust reliable people.'

13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.question: Choose the correct adjective for someone who can wait for a long time without getting angry.
13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.explanation: Düzgün cavab B variantıdır. MƏNBƏ: Lüğət hissəsindəki tərif: 'Patient people can wait for a long time without becoming angry.'

13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.question: What does "fun-loving" mean according to the textbook?
options: Someone who can wait for a long time
Someone who is calm and doesn't laugh much
Someone who enjoys telling jokes and funny stories
13. Reading & Vocabulary: Friendship & D.explanation: Düzgün cavab B variantıdır. MƏNBƏ: Dərslikdə yazılıb: 'Fun-loving people enjoy telling jokes and funny stories.'
opts: Someone who can wait for a long time
Someone who is calm and doesn't laugh much
Someone who enjoys telling jokes and funny stories

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: Which sentence correctly uses the Zero Conditional?
options: If you mix water and electricity, you get a shock.
If you mix water and electricity, you will get a shock.
If you mix water and electricity, you got a shock.
If you mixed water and electricity, you get a shock.
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslik qaydası: Ümumi faktları və həmişə doğru olan şeyləri bildirmək üçün hər iki hissədə İndiki Sadə (Present Simple) zaman istifadə olunur. MƏNBƏ: You use if or when with the Present Simple followed by the Present Simple in the main clause to talk about facts and things which are generally true. (If you mix water and electricity, you get a shock.)
opts: If you mix water and electricity, you get a shock.
If you mix water and electricity, you will get a shock.
If you mix water and electricity, you got a shock.
If you mixed water and electricity, you get a shock.

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: Complete the sentence using the Zero Conditional: If you heat ice, it ___.
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslikdə sıfırıncı şərt budaq cümləsi (Zero Conditional) ümumi həqiqətləri ifadə edir və hər iki tərəfdə Present Simple (İndiki Sadə zaman) istifadə olunur. Mübtəda 'it' olduğu üçün felin sonuna '-s' əlavə edilir. MƏNBƏ: If you heat ice, it melts.

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: Complete the sentence correctly: Plants ___ if they don't get enough water.
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslik qaydası: Ümumi faktları bildirərkən 'If + Present Simple, Present Simple' istifadə edilir. 'Plants' cəm ism olduğuna görə 'die' forması uyğundur. MƏNBƏ: Plants die if they don't get enough water.

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: What happens if people eat too much according to the Zero Conditional examples?
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslikdə verilmiş Zero Conditional nümunələrinə əsasən, faktlardan bəhs edərkən If + Present Simple, Present Simple qaydası tətbiq olunur. MƏNBƏ: If people eat too much, they get fat.

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: Which of the following is a correct First Conditional sentence?
options: If I will go there tomorrow, I meet my friends.
If I am going there tomorrow, I meet my friends.
If I go there tomorrow, I met my friends.
If I go there tomorrow, I will meet my friends.
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslik qaydası: Birinci şərt budaq cümləsi gələcəkdə baş verməsi mümkün olan hadisələr üçündür. Budaq cümlə İndiki Sadə (Present Simple), baş cümlə Gələcək (Future will) zamanla düzəlir. MƏNBƏ: We use the First Conditional to talk about something which is possible to happen in the future. (If I go there tomorrow, I will meet my friends.)
opts: If I will go there tomorrow, I meet my friends.
If I am going there tomorrow, I meet my friends.
If I go there tomorrow, I met my friends.
If I go there tomorrow, I will meet my friends.

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: Complete the sentence using the First Conditional: If we become friends, we ___ a lot of fun together.
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslikdə gələcəyə aid ehtimallar üçün First Conditional nümunəsi verilmişdir: If-clause (Present Simple), Main clause (will). MƏNBƏ: If we become friends, we will have a lot of fun together.

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: I will ask him to call you ___.
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslikdəki qaydaya görə baş cümlə (Main clause - will) əvvəldə də gələ bilər, lakin 'if' olan hissədə yenə də İndiki Sadə (Present Simple) zaman istifadə olunur. MƏNBƏ: If I see Nick, I'll ask him to call you.

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: Complete the sentence based on the First Conditional: If the weather is cold, we ___ on our coats.
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslik tapşırığına əsasən, müəyyən bir şərt ödənilərsə, gələcəkdəki hərəkəti (First Conditional) bildirmək üçün 'will' istifadə edilir. MƏNBƏ: If the weather is cold, we will put on our coats.

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: Choose the correct tense based on the Zero Conditional rule: Water ___ if you heat it to 100 °C.
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslikdə Zero Conditional elmi faktlar üçün işlənir, hər iki tərəfdə Present Simple olur. 'Water' sayılmayan və tək isim olduğu üçün feilə '-s' əlavə olunur. MƏNBƏ: Water boils if you heat it to 100 °C.

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: Read the sentence and choose the correct option: If it snows this winter, I ___ a snowman.
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslikdəki 'Review' hissəsində bu cümlə gələcəkdəki xüsusi və mümkün bir hadisə (First Conditional) olaraq qeyd edilmişdir. MƏNBƏ: If it snows this winter, I will make a snowman.

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: Complete the sentence: I don't go to school if I ___ sick.
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslikdə Zero Conditional üçün 'to be' felinin indiki zaman formalarından (am/is/are) istifadə olunduğu nümunə verilmişdir. Hər iki tərəf indiki zamandadır. MƏNBƏ: I don't go to school if I am sick.

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: Complete the sentence based on the textbook examples: If babies are hungry, they ___.
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslikdə Zero Conditional (ümumi həqiqət) nümunəsi kimi göstərilib: If + Present Simple, Present Simple. MƏNBƏ: If babies are hungry, they cry.

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: Complete the sentence: If they are late, their teacher ___ angry.
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslikdə verilmiş First Conditional nümunəsi olaraq gələcəkdə ehtimal olunan nəticəni bildirmək üçün 'will' istifadə edilmişdir. MƏNBƏ: If they are late, their teacher will be angry.

14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.question: Which sentence shows the correct punctuation for a First Conditional sentence according to the textbook?
options: I will meet my friends, if I go there tomorrow.
If I will go there tomorrow, I meet my friends.
If I go there tomorrow I will meet my friends.
I will meet my friends if I go there tomorrow.
14. Grammar: Zero Conditional & First Co.explanation: Dərslikdə xüsusi olaraq qeyd edilir ki, baş cümlə (Main clause) əvvəldə gəldikdə vergül qoyulmur, ancaq 'If' ilə başlayan cümlədə vergül qoyulur. MƏNBƏ: Pay attention to the punctuation. I will meet my friends if I go there tomorrow.
opts: I will meet my friends, if I go there tomorrow.
If I will go there tomorrow, I meet my friends.
If I go there tomorrow I will meet my friends.
